monday.description: Balanced by design: one compound, one integrated, and one isolation pairing — each with one push and one pull.

tuesday.description: Use controlled depth and conservative loading. The first squat round can be a lighter ramp-up; no separate warm-up block is needed.

wednesday.description: Keep pressing neutral-grip and seated. Use light, controlled ranges for cuff work and replace anything that causes painful catching.

thursday.description: Chest and shoulder presses stay with dumbbells. Cable flyes use a comfortable range; overhead triceps work stays seated.

friday.description: Keep hinges crisp and conservative. The three PT total-body activator slots are fixed and carry forward into every new week.

saturday.description: An optional flexible session. Choose any compatible exercises from the library and adjust the circuit difficulty to fit your week.

sunday.description: An optional lighter session for mobility, core, balance, or any movements you want to practice.
